label: business or organization based or located in
definition: Business or organization X is based or physically located in geographic place Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the earlier location predicate. Explicit based-in/firm-in/company-in paths qualify. Corporate or industry noun modifiers such as Bell or Internet are not assumed to be geographic places. A shortened firm name can be resolved locally by explicit firm constructions.

facts.reason: Internet modifies firm/company as an industry or business domain, not a geographic location for Forrester Research.
Real Capital Analytics is explicitly a firm/company in New York and based there.
Petroleum Finance Company is explicitly in Washington and based there.
Kohlberg is explicitly a firm based in New York; firm/house wording supplies the organizational use of the shortened name.
Bell modifies company and employee context, giving corporate affiliation rather than a geographic place for Ameritech Corporation.
